run_mh_update: run one Metropolis-Hastings Monte Carlo step using an all-electron move with Gaussian proposal
run_mh_block_update: run one Metropolis-Hastings step for a block of electrons with symmetric Gaussian proposal
run_mh_accept: run the MH accept or reject step given current state, proposal, and log probabilities
build_make_mcmc_step: build an MCMC step function that performs multiple Metropolis-Hastings moves with configurable width and blocks
run_update_mcmc_width: run adaptive MCMC width update based on recent acceptance ratios and configurable thresholds
